notes.title: Hell gets a devilish discount and a Twitch Stream!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Art/Hell/MX_Spotlight.jpg[/img]
There is a day when it is said that Demons and evil spirits are free to walk the mortal world and the forces of Evil are able to unleash their power with no limitations.

Whether you fight to survive and defeat this darkness or if you choose to bring destruction to the living, you will agree on this judgment: it’s time to release some [b]HELL![/b]

Brace your selves! [i]Halloween is here[/i] and we have just the right game to enjoy it!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/312420/]Hell[/url], the turn-based tactical skirmish strategy game developed by award winning developer Hunted Cow , gets a [b]devilish discount for the entire weekend - until November 2nd  -  you will have the chance to grab this game 66% off![/b]

Set in the mythical fantasy land of Gilrand, you take control of either the good ‘Order of Radiance’ or the evil ‘Demons of Hell’ and battle for supremacy across many different battlefields and environments in this clever strategy game.  Each unit has been carefully designed to have a specific role in the battle, with various strengths and weaknesses determined from an array of unique abilities and traits.

And if you want more of a taste, don’t miss the [b]Twitch Stream of the game on Saturday 31st at 20:00 CEST / 18:00 UTC / 2:00 PM EDT[/b] on our official [url=www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch Channel![/url]

Happy Helloween!

notes.title: Hell is in a weekly Humble Bundle!
notes.notes:
What have the Middle Ages, the Second World War, Ancient Rome and Hellish demons got in common?

Probably nothing, apart from the fact they are the settings of our games in the [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/weekly]Weekly Humble Bundle![/url]

Starting today a huge list of Slitherine/Matrix games will be available through the Humble section.

You can [b]name your price for Conquest! Medieval Realms, Frontline: Road to Moscow, Battle Academy, and Rise of Prussia Gold.[/b]

If you wish, you can pay [b]$6 or more to receive Qvadriga and Hell[/b] as well.

And last but not least, [b]for only $10 or more you will receive all of the above plus Close Combat: Gateway to Caen,[/b] the latest release in the critically-acclaimed Close Combat series!

Don’t miss the opportunity to play these amazing games and help a charity at the same time!

notes.notes:

• Fixed a few bugs that could cause the tutorial to break.

• Greatly increased AI performance.

notes.title: Hell Update 1.0.3 Available Now
notes.notes:
Hell Update [b]1.0.3[/b] is now available!

[h1]Patch Notes :[/h1]
[list]
[*]Skirmish Mode now available
[*]Co-Op Multiplayer now available
[*]Various bug fixes
[*]Increased SFX range
[*]Random Spawns added to some Multiplayer Maps
[*]More information is now available pre game in Multiplayer via a mouse over.
[*]Camera no longer moves to positions that player cannot see during enemy turn.
[*]Updated an incorrect tool-tip on broken units.
[/list]

[img=http://files.huntedcow.com/hell/knight_render.png]

We're also very thankful to all our players for their feedback on the launch of the game, and would love to hear your thoughts on improving the game further!

notes.title: Hell Development Update!
notes.notes:
[img=http://files.huntedcow.com/hell/hellion_knight_render.png]
Hey folks!

We'd like to start by thanking everyone who purchased our game 'Hell' and just wanted to give you a quick update on our plans going forward. We're hoping to have a patch v1.1 out very soon!

[list][*]Fixed an issue where mission 3 could occasionally fail even if all victory conditions were met.
[*]Improved AI performance.
[*]Added Co-Op Multiplayer to all campaign levels.
[*]Fixed an issue when zooming out SFX would disappear completely.
[*]Updated an incorrect tooltip on broken units.
[*]Fixed an issue where Stunned units could Overwatch fire
[*]Fixed an issue where  Stunned units can be Knockback-moved.
[*]Added Tooltip descriptions to all Multiplayer Levels.
[*]Follow-Up actions no longer consume movement points.
[*]Reinforcements added to the following multiplayer maps : The Bowl, Crossroads and Dramweed[/list]
Please note there may be some additional fixes by the time the patch is ready to release however we'll ensure to keep you updated!

~The Hunted Cow Team
